відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"version\":\"1\",\"text\":\"For a charity evening where you speak and your husband wears a tuxedo, I chose a single matching suit, so you look composed and pulled together next to him. The shoes carry the one stronger colour, and the bag, earrings and necklace round out the evening without competing with them. The suit is a touch gentler than full formal, so the necklace and earrings do the dressing up. The fitted top with the flared trousers gives you one clean vertical line. The close fit through the middle is the anchor, so the flare below reads as intentional.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Wear the necklace and earrings together, because they are what lifts the suit to a formal evening.\",\"Let the shoes be the only stronger colour and keep everything else quiet around them.\",\"Let the longer strands of the necklace fall down the front of the suit top to extend the vertical line.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[\"#498·21\"],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#221·00\",\"what\":\"the suit\"},{\"n\":\"#151·10\",\"what\":\"the shoes\"},{\"n\":\"#123·07\",\"what\":\"the bag\"},{\"n\":\"#498·21\",\"what\":\"the earrings\"},{\"n\":\"#330·13\",\"what\":\"the necklace\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#221·00\",\"text\":\"Its level suits an evening in a restaurant where you present. It sits slightly under full formal, which I chose on purpose and balanced with the jewelry.\"},{\"n\":\"#151·10\",\"text\":\"Its level suits the occasion. I chose it on purpose as the single stronger colour of the outfit, even though it sits a little below full formal. I cannot say how long you will be on your feet in them.\"},{\"n\":\"#123·07\",\"text\":\"I chose this bag on purpose as the one finishing piece. It is among the pricier bags I could have picked, and I think it earns that for an evening like this. I cannot say how much it will hold for you.\"},{\"n\":\"#498·21\",\"text\":\"I chose these earrings on purpose as part of the evening jewelry, kept quiet beside the stronger colour of the shoes.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":30335,"output_tokens":2761},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
